description: Compare available driving, transit, walking, and bicycling route summaries between two places using Google Maps. Returns duration and distance estimates for supported modes, plus Uber, Lyft, Waymo, and Google Maps handoff buttons for the destination. Set origin to 'home' for the user's saved home address. Ground time excludes airport check-in and security. Fares, detailed legs, flights, and ferries are unavailable.

destination.description: Ending place or address (1 to 300 characters).

modes.description: Modes to compare. Defaults to all four.

origin.description: Starting place or address (1 to 300 characters), or 'home' for the user's private saved home address.

time.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit UTC offset. Required for leave_by or arrive_by; omit for leave_now.

name: get_routes
title: Get Routes
